prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: eight-frame animation sprite sheet for a 128x128 side-scrolling RPG. Input is the exact enemy design. Match its identity, colors, material shading, outline thickness and detail level in every frame. Output ONE landscape sheet, ideally 2048x1024, EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells, 8 frames in row-major order. Each cell contains ONE complete pose of the SAME character, all facing LEFT, fixed side camera. Keep identical physical body scale across all 8 poses, fixed lighting and stable textures. Entire body, hands, feet and trailing parts fit WITHIN each cell with generous empty margins, no overlap between cells. Same ground baseline in every cell at 88% cell height; allow clearance ABOVE for raised limbs. Feet stay aligned in place; no camera motion or zoom. Background UNIFORM SOLID BLUE-GRAY #8b9bb4, easily removed later. No ground line, puddle, shadow, dust, speed lines, glow, text, labels, cell borders or checkerboard. Crisp pixel art, rich but controlled shading, not smooth painting. Final frame must follow the stated ending exactly.
Subject invariants: A massive BROAD creature made ENTIRELY of TANGLED INTERLOCKING DEAD ROOTS tightly bound by vines. Dense uneven torso almost twice human breadth, jagged broken roots on one shoulder, flattened wooden-knot head with two uneven dark hollows and horizontal mouth split, no glow. Huge disproportionately long arms with enormous bundled-root fists, short sturdy root legs and broad splayed-root feet. Peat-brown and weathered gray wet bark, pale split fibers, black mud gaps, dull-green binding vines. Wood remains visibly many distinct interwoven roots across chest, abdomen, arms and legs, never flesh or smooth muscular anatomy. No leaves, flowers, canopy, clothing or weapons.
Animation: One-shot simultaneous TWO-FIST OVERHEAD GROUND SLAM, all facing LEFT: 1 ready fists low; 2 BOTH arms raise together; 3 BOTH gigantic fists held ABOVE head, knees braced; 4 BOTH fists hit ground TOGETHER in front LEFT, torso folds forward; 5 BOTH fists planted on ground bearing weight; 6 pushes up using both hands; 7 arms lower while straightening; 8 original upright ready pose. Keep same body scale in every cell, extra overhead clearance in ALL cells. Both fists and all feet fully fit. Entire body remains tangled dead roots, never flesh. NO single-arm punch, no forward turn.
